Loader starts term-scoped plan summaries and phase controls concurrently; each region renders and retries independently. Offering detail is lazy in the editor; save patches its summary. Tap preload avoids false-positive traffic for the bounded 500-offering plan read.
Route loader owns the cohesive activity overview; version history stays lazy in the sheet and partial mutations invalidate only the overview dependency.
Route loader owns the subject-group cards; typed create, update, and delete mutations patch only the local collection.
Route loader owns the cohesive subject overview; version history stays lazy in the sheet and partial mutations invalidate only the overview dependency.
Route loads one bounded setup workspace for years, terms, and bell schedules; period details remain lazy and mutations patch or refresh only affected year schedules.
Route loads cohesive curriculum overview; create options remain lazy on dialog open and returned item patches overview locally.

Route starts curriculum and version list together, explicit structure and optional alignment independently; absent version waits only for list selection. Create/management options remain permission-gated and action-lazy, with focused regional retry and shallow version URL updates.
Route loader starts homerooms and change-set summaries; selected detail follows its ID and offerings tab stays lazy.

Independent offering/groups and direct selected-group route reads; versions depend only on offering term and published membership history on selected group. Heavy detail links preload on tap; management and roster actions stay lazy.
Route-owned term round list with stable skeleton, focused retry, and local create/delete patch; unbounded term list does not data-preload.

Route-owned workspace paints before dependent grade-level options; heavy detail links preload on tap. Room options load only on the managed rooms tab, invigilator/staff options only on their tab, and exports only on action.

Route-owned visible-tab subjects and selected-group workspace are dependent streamed regions. Inactive tabs, criterion configuration, and permission-gated manager controls load only on interaction; URL selection uses shallow replaceState to avoid duplicate route reads. Score/evaluation save queues and focused phase refresh remain local.
One bounded route-owned homeroom/advisor/grade/program workspace; staff lookup stays lazy on advisor action.

Year-scoped 50-row cursor list starts in the route after layout permissions settle. First skeleton, retained refresh/error/retry, year supersession, and typed create patch are verified. Create-dialog policy options remain lazy behind manage permission.

Selected run workspace and display references start independently after layout permission resolution. Workspace skeleton/error/retry, delayed sibling, retained refresh, and exact mutation/idempotency flows are browser verified. Homeroom search, correction impacts, and command reads remain action-lazy; large workspace link uses tap preload.

Bounded policy-version list starts in the route after layout permissions settle. First skeleton and focused retry are verified; existing rows remain during refresh. Grade/program/progression references stay lazy on the exact read/manage dialog and typed policy creation patches the list.

Route streams independent bounded 20-question list/summary and subject options. Subject and list failures retry independently; list search/page uses latest-request cancellation, detail and editor are action-lazy, and export remains action-lazy. Tap preload avoids expensive incidental hover reads.

Route streams the bounded 100-row effective-result search for URL-owned term and filters. First skeleton, retained same-query refresh, localized retry, supersession and typed correction patch are verified; correction dialog remains action-only. Tap preload avoids incidental search traffic.

Route streams only the active lock tab readiness; course/activity share one result read and learner readiness loads on its tab. Each queue has focused skeleton/error/retry, URL-owned tab, supersession, and typed lock patches without broad refetch. Tap preload avoids expensive incidental readiness reads.

Route-owned active-section overview and grading policy start independently. An explicit selected group starts its workspace in parallel with overview; default group selection depends on overview. Selected learner summary depends on the learner workspace. Inactive sections load on interaction; confirmation patches workspace and refreshes only readiness. URL selection uses shallow replaceState.

Term roster and policy reads start independently after layout-owned current-user permissions settle. Explicit selected revision history starts separately; preview starts immediately for an explicit policy or after the policy list for a default policy. URL selection, per-region skeleton/error/retry, stale-policy fallback, and focused lock/policy mutation patches are verified. Unbounded year/term roster uses tap preload.

Year roster starts after layout-owned current-user permissions settle; explicit selected annual preview and history start independently without waiting for roster. URL selection, per-region skeleton/error/retry, retained refresh, and typed lock patch are verified. Unbounded year roster uses tap preload.
One route-owned student-year/placement/homeroom workspace; candidates and grade/program options load only in the manage-only create dialog.
